description: Step-up action kinds: a step-up token is issued for exactly one kind and accepted only by the privileged routes of that kind. Every kind of the desktop enum StepUpActionKind (src-tauri/src/vps/vendor_admin_console.rs) is listed with its Rust variant; kinds the desktop does not have yet are listed with rust_variant null and must be added there (drift check: api/scripts/step-up-kinds-drift.mjs).

kinds.description: Revoke a licence or suspend a tenant.
Roll an update policy back or recall a rollout.
Set an update policy, pause or resume a rollout.
Revoke, reinstate, release or rebind one machine slot.
Replay or repair a device's sync state.
Create, change or disable a vendor operator, or reset their MFA.
Delete a tenant and purge its synchronised data (irreversible).
Create or revoke a release workflow (CI) publisher key.
